sections: Semiconductor-metal transition in thin films grown by ozone based atomic layer deposition VO2

Semiconductor-metal transition in thin VO2 films grown by ozone based atomic layer deposition

figures.caption: FIG. 1. ALD characteristics for the process TEMAV-O3 at 150 °C: ( a ) Growth per cycle vs exposure times for TEMAV with a fixed O 3 exposure of 5 s ( filled symbols ) and for O 3 with a fixed TEMAV exposure of 2 s ( open symbols ) ; ( b ) Thickness of the deposited films as a function of the number of ALD cycles.
FIG. 2. ( Color online ) XPS of ( a ) an as deposited O 3-grown ALD film, and ( b ) a film grown by an O 2 -plasma enhanced ALD process with long plasma exposure.

FIG. 3. XRD spectra of an O 3 -grown ALD films, the same film annealed for 30 min in He at 450 °C and a film grown by an O 2 -plasma enhanced ALD process with long plasma exposure. In the inset, a SEM picture is shown for the annealed O 3-grown ALD film.

FIG. 4. ( Color online ) Integrated intensity for the diffraction peak of the VO2 ( R ) 110 plane during an isothermal anneal of 30 min at 450 °C in He for a film of 42 nm. The inset shows the in situ XRD measurement from which the peak intensity was integrated.

FIG. 5. SMT as observed during a thermal cycle between 30 and 100 °C, with fixed heating and cooling rate of 0.1 °C / s: ( a ) in situ XRD, showing the change in crystal structure, ( b ) the correlated change in resistivity, and ( c ) a Gaussian curve fit to d [ -log ( r )] / d T for the analysis of the resistivity.
